tasks.label: Release: cut new version
tasks.detail: Bump version files, commit, tag (pcxa--v<version>), push. Idempotent — safe to re-run after a partial failure.

tasks.label: Release: re-publish existing tag
tasks.detail: Trigger the GitHub release workflow against an already-pushed tag (rebuilds notes, refreshes the release). Use after a workflow failure.

tasks.label: Release: show current version
tasks.detail: Print the version recorded in each of the 5 source-of-truth sites.
args: echo 'pyproject.toml      :' $(grep -E '^version = ' pyproject.toml | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/'); echo 'pcxa/__init__.py    :' $(grep -E '^__version__' pcxa/__init__.py | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/'); echo 'plugin.json         :' $(jq -r '.version' .claude-plugin/plugin.json); echo 'marketplace.json top:' $(jq -r '.version' .claude-plugin/marketplace.json); echo 'marketplace plugin  :' $(jq -r '.plugins[0].version' .claude-plugin/marketplace.json)
